( t.description = 'RATE_MIDDLEMAN_FEE' OR t.description LIKE 'MARKUP X %' OR t.description LIKE 'CHARGE % PLATFORM FEE' )

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM transactions_rate tr WHERE tr.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tr.rate_group_id = t.rate_group_id AND tr.middleman_account_id IS NOT NULL AND t.id <> tr.leg1_transaction_id AND t.id <> tr.leg2_transaction_id )

SELECT UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'WIN' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END ), 0) AS bfAmount FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.bank_process_posted_id IS NOT NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_type IN ('WIN', 'LOSE') AND t.transaction_date < #{dateFrom}
AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
GROUP BY c.code ORDER BY currencyCode ASC

SELECT UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'WIN' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END ), 0) AS bfAmount FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.bank_process_posted_id IS NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_type IN ('WIN', 'LOSE') AND t.transaction_date < #{dateFrom}
AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
GROUP BY c.code ORDER BY currencyCode ASC

SELECT t.id AS id, t.transaction_type AS transactionType, t.amount AS amount, CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'WIN' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END AS signedAmount, t.transaction_date AS transactionDate, t.description AS description, t.remark AS remark, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.created_at AS createdAt, UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, bp.card_owner AS cardOwner, TRUE AS bankProcessLine FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id INNER JOIN bank_process_accounting_posted bpap ON bpap.id = t.bank_process_posted_id INNER JOIN bank_process bp ON bp.id = bpap.bank_process_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.bank_process_posted_id IS NOT NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_type IN ('WIN', 'LOSE') AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo}
AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC

SELECT t.id AS id, t.transaction_type AS transactionType, t.amount AS amount, CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'WIN' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END AS signedAmount, t.transaction_date AS transactionDate, t.description AS description, t.remark AS remark, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.created_at AS createdAt, UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, NULL AS cardOwner, TRUE AS bankProcessLine, TRUE AS dataCaptureLine, dcl.id_product AS idProduct, dcl.rate_expression AS rateExpression FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN data_capture_line dcl ON dcl.transaction_id = t.id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.bank_process_posted_id IS NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_type IN ('WIN', 'LOSE') AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo}
AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC

SELECT t.id AS id, t.transaction_type AS transactionType, t.amount AS amount, CASE WHEN t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.from_account_id IS NULL AND THEN t.amount WHEN t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.from_account_id = #{accountId} THEN 0 WHEN t.account_id = #{accountId} THEN -t.amount ELSE t.amount END AS signedAmount, t.transaction_date AS transactionDate, t.description AS description, t.remark AS remark, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.created_at AS createdAt, UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, NULL AS cardOwner, FALSE AS bankProcessLine, t.account_id AS toAccountId, t.from_account_id AS fromAccountId, to_a.account_id AS toAccountCode, from_a.account_id AS fromAccountCode, t.rate_group_id AS rateGroupId, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(tr.rate_expression), ''), TRIM(TRAILING '.' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(tr.exchange_rate AS CHAR))) ) AS rateExpression, UPPER(cf.code) AS rateCurrencyFromCode, tr.amount_from AS rateAmountFrom, UPPER(ct.code) AS rateCurrencyToCode, CASE WHEN tr.middleman_account_id IS NOT NULL AND t.id <> tr.leg1_transaction_id AND t.id <> tr.leg2_transaction_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rateMiddlemanFee, UPPER(leg1_to.account_id) AS rateLeg1ToAccountCode, tr.middleman_rate AS rateMiddlemanRate, tr.middleman_rate_expression AS rateMiddlemanRateExpression, tr.exchange_rate AS rateExchangeRate, CASE WHEN t.description = 'RATE_MIDDLEMAN_FEE' OR t.description LIKE 'MARKUP X %' OR t.description LIKE 'CHARGE % PLATFORM FEE' THEN 'FEE' WHEN t.description = 'RATE_MIDDLEMAN_RATE' OR (t.description LIKE 'MARKUP %' AND t.description NOT LIKE 'MARKUP X %') THEN 'RATE' WHEN tr.middleman_rate IS NOT NULL AND tr.middleman_rate > 0 THEN 'RATE' ELSE 'FEE' END AS rateMiddlemanKind FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id INNER JOIN account to_a ON to_a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN account from_a ON from_a.id = t.from_account_id LEFT JOIN transactions_rate tr ON tr.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tr.rate_group_id = t.rate_group_id LEFT JOIN currency cf ON cf.id = tr.currency_from_id AND cf.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN currency ct ON ct.id = tr.currency_to_id AND ct.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN transactions leg1_t ON leg1_t.id = tr.leg1_transaction_id LEFT JOIN account leg1_to ON leg1_to.id = leg1_t.account_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.bank_process_posted_id IS NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_type IN () AND ( t.account_id = #{accountId} OR t.from_account_id = #{accountId} ) AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo}
AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC

SELECT UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS bfAmount FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.bank_process_posted_id IS NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_type = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND t.transaction_date < #{dateFrom}
AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
GROUP BY c.code ORDER BY currencyCode ASC

SELECT t.id AS id, t.transaction_type AS transactionType, t.amount AS amount, t.amount AS signedAmount, t.transaction_date AS transactionDate, t.description AS description, t.remark AS remark, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.created_at AS createdAt, UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, NULL AS cardOwner, FALSE AS bankProcessLine FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.bank_process_posted_id IS NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_type = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo}
AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC

SELECT t.id AS id, t.transaction_type AS transactionType, t.amount AS amount, CASE WHEN t.account_id = #{accountId} AND t.from_account_id = #{accountId} THEN 0 WHEN t.account_id = #{accountId} THEN -t.amount ELSE t.amount END AS signedAmount, t.transaction_date AS transactionDate, t.description AS description, t.remark AS remark, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.created_at AS createdAt, UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, NULL AS cardOwner, FALSE AS bankProcessLine, t.account_id AS toAccountId, t.from_account_id AS fromAccountId, to_a.account_id AS toAccountCode, from_a.account_id AS fromAccountCode FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id INNER JOIN account to_a ON to_a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN account from_a ON from_a.id = t.from_account_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.bank_process_posted_id IS NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_type = 'PROFIT' AND ( t.account_id = #{accountId} OR t.from_account_id = #{accountId} ) AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo}
AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC
